headline: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Q2 profit rises 30% to ₹39 Cr
hook: Strong growth for auto component maker
summary: SEDEMAC Mechatronics reported a 30% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹39.2 Cr for the second quarter. Revenue for the period grew by 40% compared to the same quarter last year. The company specializes in manufacturing auto components and mechatronics solutions. This performance reflects sustained demand in the automotive supply chain.
why_it_matters: Signals robust demand for domestic auto component manufacturers.

headline: SEDEMAC Mechatronics reports 18% sequential profit rise in Q2
hook: Supply risks shadow SEDEMAC's strong Q2
summary: SEDEMAC Mechatronics reported an 18% quarter-on-quarter increase in net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue for the period rose 29% sequentially compared to the previous quarter. Despite the earnings growth, the company flagged operational challenges, including semiconductor shortages and elevated commodity costs. It also cited weather-related risks as potential disruptions to near-term demand.
why_it_matters: Chip shortages and input costs could pressure future profitability.
